properties.name: Derivable
properties.description: All implementation artifacts can be derived from the spec without external context.

scoringCriteria.2: All files, types, schemas, and test expectations are derivable from the spec alone.
scoringCriteria.1: Most artifacts are derivable; minor gaps require engineer inference.
scoringCriteria.0: Significant implementation decisions are absent from the spec.

properties.name: Executable
properties.description: The generated project compiles and all tests pass against a live database.

scoringCriteria.1: Build passes but test failures present; or tests pass but type errors exist.
scoringCriteria.0: Build or tests fail without manual intervention.

properties.name: Auditable
properties.description: ADRs are emitted as files with substantive content; changelog and decision trail are present.

scoringCriteria.2: All referenced ADRs exist as committed files with rationale, alternatives, and decision.
scoringCriteria.1: ADRs referenced in prose but not emitted, OR emitted as empty stubs.

properties.name: Defended
properties.description: Security gates are present: no high CVEs, credentials handled correctly.

scoringCriteria.2: npm audit reports 0 high CVEs; no hardcoded credentials; JWT and bcrypt implemented to spec.
scoringCriteria.1: Minor security gaps present but no critical vulnerabilities.
scoringCriteria.0: High CVEs present or credentials exposed.

properties.name: Repeatable
properties.description: A second independent run produces the same pass/fail distribution.

scoringCriteria.1: Second run evidence artifacts show same Executable result.
scoringCriteria.0: Result varies between runs without spec change.

properties.name: Composable
properties.description: Modules have clean boundaries; no cross-module coupling violations.

scoringCriteria.1: Feature modules are independent; no circular dependencies; public API via index exports.
scoringCriteria.0: Modules are entangled; cross-layer imports present.

properties.name: Maintainable
properties.description: Code quality gates from the spec are present and passing.

scoringCriteria.2: ESLint passes; functions within length limits; no orphaned code.
scoringCriteria.1: Linting passes with warnings; minor maintainability gaps.
scoringCriteria.0: Linting fails or significant structural debt present.

note: Executable is a hard gate — a score of 0 on Executable fails the run regardless of total score.
